name: Coherence
description: The degree to which the response is logically consistent and flows naturally from the context provided.

name: Relevance
description: The extent to which the response is directly related to the context and the previous statements in the conversation.

name: Creativity
description: The originality and freshness of the response, including the use of interesting and novel ideas or expressions.

name: Engagement
description: The ability of the response to maintain or enhance the interest and involvement of the conversational partner.

name: Factual Accuracy
description: The accuracy of any factual information or statements included in the response.

name: Contextual Appropriateness
description: The appropriateness of the response given the social and situational context of the conversation.
